description: The symbol support of a scoped formula is the finite set of all its occurring function and relation symbols, tagged separately and with their arities.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} {n : ℕ} :
  L.BoundedFormula α n → Finset L.Symbols
